findings: The physical harness referenced nonexistent test-p15d1-gui-manual-invariants.ps1, guaranteeing a safe pre-token failure if later authorized.
The physical harness hard barrier did not directly re-assert P15C physicalPassed/evidenceClosed and both P15C gates re-blocked.
The evidence packager omitted p15d1-parent-owned-verified.txt, weakening durable proof of the first parent ownership fence.
The tray Exit path proved the GUI had been hidden, but did not prove it was still hidden if the user reopened it before Exit.
fixes: Use test-p15d1-tray-exit-invariants.ps1 and rerun the P15C invariant before any operator token.
Directly require P15C physical PASS/evidence closure and both P15C execution gates closed in the parent harness.
Fail closed on reopen after the qualified hide and require Visible=false plus ShowInTaskbar=false at tray Exit.
